episodes.208400: Winds became gusty behind a cold front during the night of November 3 into the early morning hours of November 4.
episodes.208672: A broken line of showers/thunderstorms developed over the eastern half of the area as a cold front and pre-frontal trough approached. This line produced isolated damaging wind gusts over the waters.
episodes.208935: On the evening of November 3rd, a cold front crossed the region and was then followed by an area of showers over Lake Ontario that tracked southeast into Monroe County. The showers then strengthened to severe thunderstorms as they encountered stronger shear. The thunderstorms caused 1.00 inch hail in Monroe County and caused some wind damage in parts of Ontario County.
